description: This file is a C++ header (.h) file defining the class 'PackagerImplementation' within the 'WPEFramework::Plugin' namespace. It declares the class, its member variables, nested classes, and method signatures related to package management, configuration, and repository synchronization for a software packaging plugin. It also includes interface implementations, data structures for package info, installation info, and threading logic.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IPackager interface for managing software packages, including configuration, installation, and synchronization functionalities.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class for JSON configuration storage related to PackagerImplementation.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: JSON configuration class for plugin-specific settings, such as system root path.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Implements IPackager::IPackageInfo, representing package metadata like name, version, and architecture.

classes.name: InstallInfo
classes.description: Implements IPackager::IInstallationInfo, representing ongoing installation status, progress, and error states.

classes.name: InstallationData
classes.description: Data structure holding pointers to PackageInfo and InstallInfo during installation processes.

classes.name: InstallThread
classes.description: Thread class for performing installation tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for package events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from package events.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package provider with the given service.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package with specified name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: SynchronizeRepository
methods.description: Synchronizes the package repository with the local system.
